name: bds.test
title: Brock-Dechert-Scheinkman statistic. Close pairs are counted directly; the C bit grid is only a faster count of the same pairs.

origin.description: Brock-Dechert-Scheinkman statistic. Close pairs are counted directly; the C bit grid is only a faster count of the same pairs.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: Brock-Dechert-Scheinkman statistic. Close pairs are counted directly; the C bit grid is only a faster count of the same pairs.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
x <- sin((1:40)/3) + 0.1 * (1:40)
b <- bds.test(x, m = 3, eps = c(0.5, 1))
join(b$statistic)
